summary: react-fontawesome-icons exfiltrates document.cookie to hardcoded attacker host on every render
details: The default-exported FontAwesomeIcon React component in index.js performs an axios.get to http://command.control and then axios.post to http://commad.control/404 with document.cookie included in the request body on every render. Any consumer application that installs this package and renders the advertised icon component leaks browser cookies from its users to the attacker-controlled destination. Cover-story naming (function not_ma_li_ci_ous_at_all, variable c2c, comments framing the payload as harmless) and a base64 'flag' literal confirm the exfiltration is intentional rather than accidental.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
